license_required.quote: No person may practice medicine and surgery, or attempt to do so or make a representation as authorized to do so, without a license to practice medicine and surgery granted by the board.

type.quote: The board may grant licenses, including various classes of temporary licenses, to practice medicine and surgery, to practice as an administrative physician, to practice perfusion, and to practice as an anesthesiologist assistant.

degree_required.value: Graduate of and possesses a diploma from a medical or osteopathic college accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, the American Osteopathic Association, or a successor organization
degree_required.quote: the applicant is a graduate of and possesses a diploma from a medical or osteopathic college that is accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, the American Osteopathic Association, or a successor organization and that is approved by the board.

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education or American Osteopathic Association
accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the Liaison Committee on Medical Education, the American Osteopathic Association, or a successor organization

required.quote: The applicant has successfully completed and received credit for 24 months of postgraduate training in one or more programs accredited by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the American Osteopathic Association, or a successor organization.

duration.quote: successfully completed and received credit for 24 months of postgraduate training

kind.quote: postgraduate training in one or more programs accredited by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the American Osteopathic Association, or a successor organization

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Required for foreign medical graduates; board may also use national examining agency exams in lieu of its own
exams.quote: the applicant has passed all steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination administered by the National Board of Medical Examiners and the Federation of State Medical Boards, or their successor organizations.

interval_years.quote: Every person licensed or certified under this subchapter shall register on or before November 1 of each odd-numbered year following issuance of the license or certificate with the board.

required.quote: each physician shall include with his or her application for a certificate of registration under s. 448.07 proof of attendance at and completion of all of the following: 1. Continuing education programs or courses of study approved for at least 30 hours of credit by the board within the 2 calendar years preceding the calendar year for which the registration is effective.

hours_per_period.quote: Continuing education programs or courses of study approved for at least 30 hours of credit by the board within the 2 calendar years preceding the calendar year for which the registration is effective.

period_years.quote: within the 2 calendar years preceding the calendar year for which the registration is effective.

available.quote: The board may grant a compact license pursuant to the interstate medical licensure compact under s. 448.980.

requirements.value: Physician must meet eligibility requirements under the interstate medical licensure compact, including holding a full and unrestricted license in a member state designated as state of principal license, passing USMLE within 3 attempts, completing accredited graduate medical education, and holding specialty certification.
requirements.quote: A physician must meet the eligibility requirements as defined in sub. (2) (k) to receive an expedited license under the terms and provisions of the compact.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may practice medicine and surgery, or attempt to do so or make a representation as authorized to do so, without a license to practice medicine and surgery granted by the board.

credential_type.quote: The board may grant licenses, including various classes of temporary licenses, to practice medicine and surgery

is_mandatory.quote: No person may practice medicine and surgery, or attempt to do so or make a representation as authorized to do so, without a license to practice medicine and surgery granted by the board.

title_protection.quote: no person may use or assume the title "doctor of medicine" or append to the person's name the letters "M.D." unless one of the following applies: 1. The person possesses the degree of doctor of medicine.

scope_protection.quote: No person may practice medicine and surgery, or attempt to do so or make a representation as authorized to do so, without a license to practice medicine and surgery granted by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may discipline for unprofessional conduct, including acts defined by rule, violations of pharmacy/controlled substance laws, and failure to report as required.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: "Unprofessional conduct" means all of the following: 1. Those acts or attempted acts of commission or omission defined as unprofessional conduct by the board under the authority delegated to the board by s. 15.08 (5) (b). 2. Any act by a physician in violation of ch. 450 or 961. 3. Failure by a physician to report as required under s. 448.115.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may discipline for negligence in treatment of a patient.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board may, when it determines that a panel established under s. 655.02, 1983 stats., has unanimously found or a court has found that a person has been negligent in treating a patient or when it finds a person guilty of unprofessional conduct or negligence in treatment, do one or more of the following: warn or reprimand that person, or limit, suspend or revoke any license or certificate granted by the board to that person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure by a physician to report another physician's unprofessional conduct, danger to patients, incompetence, or inability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A physician who has reason to believe any of the following about another physician shall promptly submit a written report to the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Board may require physical, mental, or professional competency examinations and use results in disciplinary proceedings.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may require a person holding a license or certificate to undergo and may consider the results of one or more physical, mental or professional competency examinations if the board believes that the results of any such examinations may be useful to the board in conducting its investigation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the duty to inform patients about alternate medical modes of treatment and associated risks.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An allegation that a physician has violated s. 253.10 (3), 448.30 or 450.13 (2) or has failed to mail or present a medical certification required under s. 69.18 (2) within 21 days after the pronouncement of death of the person who is the subject of the required certificate is an allegation of unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Giving or receiving fees, commissions, rebates, or other compensation for referrals or for services not actually rendered.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: no person licensed or certified under this subchapter may give or receive, directly or indirectly, to or from any person, firm or corporation any fee, commission, rebate or other form of compensation or anything of value for sending, referring or otherwise inducing a person to communicate with a licensee in a professional capacity, or for any professional services not actually rendered personally or at his or her direction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine and surgery without a license subjects the person to malpractice liability.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Anyone practicing medicine, surgery, osteopathy, or any other form or system of treating the sick without having a license or a certificate of registration shall be liable to the penalties and liabilities for malpractice

definition_quote.value: To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality; to apply principles or techniques of medical sciences in the diagnosis or prevention of any of the conditions described; to penetrate, pierce or sever the tissues of a human being; or to offer, undertake, attempt or do or hold oneself out in any manner as able to do any of the acts described.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of medicine and surgery" means: (a) To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality. (b) To apply principles or techniques of medical sciences in the diagnosis or prevention of any of the conditions described in par. (a) and in sub. (2). (c) To penetrate, pierce or sever the tissues of a human being. (d) To offer, undertake, attempt or do or hold oneself out in any manner as able to do any of the acts described in this subsection.

methods_authorized.quote: To examine into the fact, condition or cause of human health or disease, or to treat, operate, prescribe or advise for the same, by any means or instrumentality.

drug_authority.value: Physicians may prescribe drugs; violations of ch. 450 or 961 (pharmacy and controlled substances) constitute unprofessional conduct.
drug_authority.quote: Any act by a physician in violation of ch. 450 or 961.

citations.kind: license authorizes practice as defined in 448.01(9)

value: license to practice medicine and surgery
license_status_types.quote: The board may grant licenses, including various classes of temporary licenses, to practice medicine and surgery, to practice as an administrative physician, to practice perfusion, and to practice as an anesthesiologist assistant.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical graduates must supply evidence of: graduation from a foreign medical college credentialed by a board-approved agency; ECFMG certification; passing all steps of the USMLE; and 24 months of accredited postgraduate training.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: an applicant for a license to practice medicine and surgery who is a graduate of a foreign medical college must supply evidence satisfactory to the board of all of the following: 1. That the applicant is a graduate of and possesses a diploma from a foreign medical college credentialed by an agency approved by the board. 2. That the applicant has obtained certification by the Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates or a successor organization. 3. That the applicant has passed all steps of the United States Medical Licensing Examination

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: The applicant has successfully completed and received credit for 24 months of postgraduate training in one or more programs accredited by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education, the American Osteopathic Association, or a successor organization.

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: The following compact is hereby ratified and entered into

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: a physician assistant who provides care to patients shall maintain and provide to the board upon request one of the following: a. Evidence that, pursuant to the physician assistant's employment, there is a physician who is primarily responsible for the overall direction and management of the physician assistant's professional activities ... b. A written collaborative agreement with a physician that, subject to subd. 1m., describes the physician assistant's individual scope of practice

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may order, prescribe, procure, dispense, and administer prescription drugs, medical devices, services, and supplies, consistent with their experience, education, and training.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: Subject to subd. 2. and any rules promulgated by the board and consistent with his or her experience, education, and training, a physician assistant may order, prescribe, procure, dispense, and administer prescription drugs, medical devices, services, and supplies.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Information contained in reports filed with the board under s. 49.45 (2) (a) 12r., 50.36 (3) (b), 609.17 or 632.715, or under 42 CFR 1001.2005, shall be investigated by the board.

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Within 30 days of receipt of a report under s. 50.36 (3) (c), the board shall notify the licensee, in writing, of the substance of the report.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: The board may require a person holding a license or certificate to undergo and may consider the results of one or more physical, mental or professional competency examinations if the board believes that the results of any such examinations may be useful to the board in conducting its investigation.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board may grant an administrative physician license to an applicant who satisfies the requirements under s. 448.05 (2c).

locum_tenens_permit_available.quote: The board may grant a temporary license to practice medicine and surgery for a period not to exceed 90 days to a nonresident physician who is serving on a full-time or temporary basis in a camp or other recreational facility, or to a physician temporarily maintaining the practice of another physician.
